defects.description: The term “Finding” is required to be translated as “Вывод”, but the translation uses “заключение”.
The term “Subject” is required to be translated as “Объект обсуждения”, but the translation uses “субъекта”.
The term “Severity” should be rendered as “Уровень серьёзности”, but the translation uses the spelling “уровень серьезности”.
The heading “Escalation Reasons” (English) is not translated; the required term “Escalation Reason” should be rendered as “Причина эскалации”.
The heading “Escalation Resolution Paths” (English) is not translated; the required term “Resolution” should be rendered as “Резолюция”.
The heading “Escalation Protocol” (English) is not translated; the term “Escalation” should be rendered as “Эскалация”.
